title: Hydraulics in Civil Engineering
bookshelves: Category: Technology, Engineering, Agriculture, Industrial processes
Category: Earth Sciences, Geography, Environment, Planning
summary: On the one hand, the book closes the gap between applied civil engineering hydraulics books and standard fluid mechanics works; on the other hand, it is designed as a course that can be applied modularly. The goal is to present the facts in an understandable and descriptive way and with experiments, software, and materials that are available anywhere. This is an open access book.
